triage.h2: Not sure what's wrong? Start here.
triage.lede: Answer three quick questions and we'll show you what we'd check first, what to bring, and how to send the details to our team.
triage.q3: How soon do you need help?
triage.result_note: This is general guidance, not a diagnosis. We confirm the fault after inspection and before any work.
triage.bring_text: The device, its charger and cable, and any case or accessory that may be involved. If you have photos or a short video of the fault, bring those too.
triage.next_text: Send this summary on WhatsApp. Our team will confirm availability and the next step before you visit.
triage.tip.screen: We'd start with the display, touch response and frame. A cracked screen can sometimes hide damage to the digitizer or connectors, so we check those before quoting.
triage.tip.battery: We'd check the battery health, charging port, cable and power adapter. The cause could be the battery, the port, or the charging accessories, so bring the charger you normally use.
triage.tip.water: Liquid damage needs assessment before power is applied. Do not charge the device; bring it in as soon as you can so we can check for corrosion and board damage.
triage.tip.audio: We'd test the camera, speaker, microphone and any related connections. Bring the device and, if relevant, the case or accessory you use.
triage.tip.software: We'd check the startup state, storage, updates and any recent changes. Bring the device and, if you can, note what happened before the problem started.
triage.tip.heat: We'd check the battery, charging behaviour, vents and running temperature. Stop using the device if it is hot to the touch or swelling.
triage.tip.other: We'd start with a general assessment and confirm the fault before any work. Bring the device and anything that may be involved.
triage.fallback: Prefer to message us directly? WhatsApp +971 56 348 0513
